text: [shocked] A self-driving taxi just stopped... right on the train tracks!
This week in downtown San Diego, a Waymo robotaxi rolled onto the trolley crossing... [nervous] and stopped.
Then the bells rang. [fast] The gates came down.
[deadpan] Its two passengers did the smart thing. They got out.
And the car? [excited] It reversed, straight through the crossing gate, and broke its own back window!
[deadpan] Nobody was hurt. The transit agency is investigating. And a human had to come and drive it away.
[playfully] Would you ride in one? Send this to the friend who trusts robots with everything.
